posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie is 8-1 with a league-best 1269.1 points, and the African Bald Fraud slander is now just historical fiction.
posts.detail: Fifth straight edition I've tried to find a crack in mjwithgoldhoops' season and there isn't one — a middle-tier pedigree is about to produce the best record in Busters Anonymous.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is a 20-8, back-to-back-finalist résumé rotting at 2-7, and I'm running out of new ways to describe the wreckage.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish across two seasons and this is what 2026 looks like — the gap between pedigree and performance is still the widest in the league.

posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 7-2 but still can't out-score half this league, and a ring should buy more respect than 1026.8 points-for deserves.
posts.detail: The champ keeps winning close ones while sitting near the bottom in points-for — pedigree says contender, the scoreboard says squeaker.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-9, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is turning this into a ten-plague special.
posts.detail: Nine games, nine losses, and the man who once drafted a defensive player first overall is now authoring his own Book of Job in real time.

posts.headline: Peacemakers 🙏 are 7-2 with 1241.36 points-for and Bubble Guts is quietly building the best season of his career.
posts.detail: A guy with a 4-seed-or-worse history is suddenly top of the Titty Committee — the worst moment of his life has never felt further away.
